summary: Trump says America must win the AI race and calls for fast permits for AI infrastructure and one national standard for AI rules.

statements.quote: AI, and Data Centers, will be the Greatest Economic Development Engine in History — Bigger than Oil, Gold, Diamonds, or even the Internet.
The claim that “AI is going to take over the World” is a Hoax
We MUST have one Federal Standard instead of a patchwork of 50 State Regulatory Regimes. If we don’t, then China will easily catch us in the AI race.
I will sign a sweeping executive order to fast-track federal permitting, streamline reviews, and do everything possible to expedite construction of all major AI infrastructure projects.
statements.venue: Winning the AI Race summit speech

statements.quote: As with any such breakthrough, this technology brings the potential for bad as well as for good, for peril as well as for progress.
statements.venue: Winning the AI Race summit speech
